data.content_ref: inline:The claim asserts a concrete local-search strategy will discover structurally novel 45-comparator networks more efficiently than naive synthesis, yet simulation_refs is empty. The problem statement explicitly declares that 'a simulation described in prose with an empty simulation_refs channel is an unverified claim and will be criticized as such.' The mechanism describes an algorithm in prose (random subset evaluation, repositioning) but provides no runnable typed sandboxed Python program, so the predicted efficiency advantage over naive bottom-up synthesis is entirely unverified. This is not a mere omission of optional scope; the problem demands a simulation-discriminated account where rivals predict different measurable outcomes, and this target files no simulation at all.
